# glpi_rack_item (Resource)

GLPI rack placement of an item.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_rack" "a01" {
  name  = "A01"
  units = 42
}

resource "glpi_computer" "db" {
  name = "db-01"
}

resource "glpi_rack_item" "db" {
  rack_id   = glpi_rack.a01.id
  item_type = "Computer"
  item_id   = glpi_computer.db.id
  position  = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (Number) ID of the placed item.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype of the placed item, for example Computer or NetworkEquipment.
- `position` (Number) Lowest rack unit the item occupies.
- `rack_id` (Number) ID of the rack.

### Optional

- `background_color` (String) Background color of the item in the rack view.
- `horizontal_position` (Number) Position inside a unit shared by half-width items.
- `orientation` (Number) 0 for the front of the rack, 1 for the rear.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Reserve the units without an item.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_rack_item.example 42
```
